title: Strategies for Professional Growth
standfirst: Career skills for a technical professional — communication, interviewing, negotiation, and the shape of a working life.
instructor: Prof. Sivakumar M S, Prof. Prathap Haridoss, Lt Col Jayakumar, Prasanna G, Kartic Vaidyanathan, Shiva Subramaniam & Senthil A V

description_paragraphs: This course prepares students for corporate life and global citizenship by fostering overall personal and professional development. It develops skills in creative problem-solving, structured thinking, effective communication, teamwork, cultural awareness, and conflict resolution, while enhancing decision-making, emotional intelligence, and the ability to overcome challenges.

In-course project: The in-course project is integrated into the course and not offered separately. Students work in teams to analyze workplace challenges, address real-world problems in professional environments, and propose practical, well-reasoned solutions using concepts and frameworks covered in the course.t
